correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 68 cells reported unsupported by the adapter's supported(), listed in correctness.unsupported_cells | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, 0.11, nodes umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094 | cells come from more than one node, see the node field of every cell: umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094

low_level: Registers 30 to 168 over the 908 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (54 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 2144 to 43136 bytes, harness 0.10, 0.11 on umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094.
Adapter statics: input arrangement striped, output indices, temp storage 2112 to 10368 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, 68 cells unsupported by the adapter's contract or the device, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): latency not_guaranteed wins 1 of 53 cells (runner-up in 3), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 10 of 36 cells (runner-up in 8), throughput not_guaranteed wins 8 of 53 cells (7 as B1_det3, 1 as B1_det3@T128, runner-up in 11), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 17 of 36 cells (15 as B1_det3, 2 as B1_det3@T128, runner-up in 4).

Shuffled tie-heavy input (harness 0.11, umbriel-b200-094): latency not_guaranteed wins 0 of 33 cells (runner-up in 2), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 6 of 33 cells (3 as B1_det3, 3 as B1_det3@T512, runner-up in 7), throughput not_guaranteed wins 3 of 33 cells (runner-up in 6), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 16 of 33 cells (10 as B1_det3, 5 as B1_det3@T512, 1 as B1_det3@T128, runner-up in 9).
negative: det2 and det3 share a node only on tie_heavy input (umbriel-b200-068), where det3 is 1.3 to 5.3 percent behind B1_det2 at N 1024 to 8192. On random input the comparison is cross-node (det3 in the 068 addendum, det2 in the 047 pass): within 2 percent in latency at N 1024 and up to 15 percent at N 16384. det3 beats no umbriel-b200-047 winner (state/phase3/det3_cells_b200.md): the deterministic price is paid, not removed.
surprises: The addendum was measured on umbriel-b200-068 while the random pass ran on umbriel-b200-047, so its random-input rows sit in a node-named addendum table and the comparison with the 047 winners is cross-node. The same-node rerun on 047 never got its node (follow-up in PHASE3_PLAN.md 6.3).
open_questions: Same-node rerun against B1_det2 and B1_idx on the random-pass node, and the bf16 deterministic price at N 8192 and above.

GB200 pass on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99 (WINNERS_gb200.md): the warp and sub-warp winners agree on 359 of 376 common cells (365 of 376 when each cell is compared through the adapters both passes measured, as section 16 of the knowledge base does), the differences are named sub-warp lane-count cells, N 128 sub-warp throughput cells and warp ties within 5 percent, and in the block matrices the B1_idx against B1_det2 throughput ties fall either way. The GB200 k 64 cells at 128 threads run 3 to 15 percent slower than on B200 (hw-researcher, a generation property).
